stories.headline: President signs Ukraine aid bill into law
stories.standfirst: The President signed H.R. 4521, the Ukraine Security Assistance Act, into law on October 21. The Act appropriates funds over two fiscal years for air-defense interceptors, artillery ammunition and spare parts for vehicles in service.
